## Setup checklist
1. This replaces whatever `whizz-discover-contacts` webhook currently exists in n8n — Whizz's Contact Discovery UI already calls that exact path, so import this workflow, point it at your Apify credential below, then deactivate/delete the old one so there's only one webhook owning `whizz-discover-contacts`.
2. Open **Call Apify Google Maps Actor** → Authentication is Predefined Credential Type → Apify API. Select/create your Apify credential there (no token pasted in code).
3. Actor ID in **Build Apify Request** is `compass~crawler-google-places` (apify.com/compass/crawler-google-places) — the standard, widely-documented Google Maps scraper actor (searchStringsArray/locationQuery/maxCrawledPlacesPerSearch input, and title/phone/website/address/totalScore/placeId/cid output). Unlike the 2GIS actor this schema is well established, so field names below should need little to no adjustment — still worth a test run before relying on it.
4. **Map to Whizz Contacts** captures `placeId`/`cid` as a stable `sourceId` and `countryCode`/`city` — Whizz uses `sourceId`+platform to refresh an already-imported listing (rating, phone, website) instead of just dropping it as a duplicate on re-search, and uses the country signal so leads land under the right country in Lead Intelligence instead of "Unknown".
5. `maxCrawledPlacesPerSearch` allows up to 100 per run — raise `APIFY_MAPS_HARD_CAP` below if your Apify plan can take more.

Whizz calls this at POST https://n8n.aiingo.com/webhook/whizz-discover-contacts with body {query, location, brand, category, type, limit} and expects back {"contacts":[{name,phone,email,website,address,totalScore,url,sourceId,countryCode,city,categoryName}]}.
